real_defects.issue: wallPanelReport (panel-calculator.html) checked that n 36 in openings fit with 12 in between and at the ends, then spread their centres at length/(n+1), which leaves less than 12 in: 2 windows on a 108 in wall passed the check and failed with 'king studs overlap ... move them' though the page takes only counts. 3 windows fit 156-191 in, 4 fit 204-239 in all failed the same way. Fixed by spreading with equal gaps and flooring offsets (every gap >= 12 in); swept test over 1-8 openings.

houseSheathingPlan had the same check/spread mismatch as wallPanelReport: 22 of 843 accepted house sizes (sides 96-400 in, 4/8/12 windows) failed takeoff with king studs overlapping. Same fix; sweep test in sheathing-fuzz.test.mjs.
